svg.title: Irreplaceable data pipeline
svg.desc: The data pipeline. Five public sources: O*NET 31.0 (18,838 tasks, 53,323 job titles, skills; CC BY 4.0), Anthropic Economic Index release 2026-06-26 (observed AI use per task; CC BY), GPTs are GPTs (research labels E0, E1, E2 per task; MIT), BLS OEWS May 2025 (median wage and employment; public domain) and Microsoft Working with AI (physical-task flag and validation; CC BY 4.0). npm run data:build joins them by O*NET Task ID and SOC code, gives each task a group and an evidence level (observed 6.5%, research estimate 93.5%) and writes a SHA-256 manifest. Outputs: 923 occupation bundles, a 53,323-title search index, and the week map computed in the browser with no model call. Task groups: AI does it 370, AI speeds it up 4,659, stays yours 13,809. Validation: Spearman 0.64 against Anthropic observed exposure and 0.66 against Microsoft AI applicability.
